plain_text:
List of psychoactive substances derived from artificial fungi biotransformation. These are often novel psychedelics with no human safety data available.

Known viable substrate additions

*4-HO-DET and 4-PO-DET mushrooms derived from Psilocybe cubensis mycelium in substrate with added DET.
*4-HO-DiPT mushrooms derived from Psilocybe cubensis mycelium in substrate with added DiPT.
*4-HO-DPT mushrooms derived from Psilocybe cubensis mycelium in substrate with added DPT.
*Baeocystin (4-PO-NMT) found in Psilocybe cubensis mushrooms from mycelium in substrate with added NMT.

Substrates suspected to produce neurotoxic compounds

*4-HO-5-MeO-DMT (psilomethoxin) mushrooms derived from Psilocybe cubensis mycelium in substrate with added 5-MeO-DMT.
**Uncertain outcome: There's no guarantee this modification will create the intended compound 4-PO-5-HO-DMT (psilomethoxin). Research (see a 2023 preprint) hasn't been able to confirm psilomethoxin production in lab settings.

See also

*List of psychoactive substances, and precursor chemicals, produced by GMOs derived from genetically modified organisms

List of psychoactive substances derived from [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artificial_fungi_biotransformation artificial fungi biotransformation]. These are often novel psychedelics with no human safety data available.

== Known viable substrate additions ==

*[[4-HO-DET]] and [[Ethocybin|4-PO-DET]] mushrooms derived from ''[[Psilocybe cubensis]]'' mycelium in substrate with added [[diethyltryptamine|DET]].<ref name="Gartz">{{cite journal | vauthors = Gartz J | title = Biotransformation of tryptamine derivatives in mycelial cultures of Psilocybe | journal = Journal of Basic Microbiology | volume = 29 | issue = 6 | pages = 347–52 | year = 1989 | pmid = 2614674 | doi = 10.1002/jobm.3620290608 | s2cid = 43308695 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Read #16 4-HO-DET {{!}} TiHKAL · info |url=http://isomerdesign.com/PiHKAL/read.php?id=16&domain=tk |website=isomerdesign.com}}</ref>
*[[Ethocybin|4-HO-DiPT]] mushrooms derived from ''[[Psilocybe cubensis]]'' mycelium in substrate with added [[DiPT]].<ref name="Shulgin Online">{{cite web |title=Ask Dr. Shulgin Online: 4-Hydroxy-5-methoxy-N,N-dimethyltryptamine, Psilocybe mushrooms, Psilocin |url=http://www.cognitiveliberty.org/shulgin/blg/2005/12/4-hydroxy-5-methoxy-nn_07.html |language=en}}</ref>
*[[4-HO-DPT]] mushrooms derived from ''[[Psilocybe cubensis]]'' mycelium in substrate with added [[Dipropyltryptamine|DPT]].<ref name="Shulgin Online" />
*[[Baeocystin]] (4-PO-NMT) found in ''[[Psilocybe cubensis]]'' mushrooms from mycelium in substrate with added [[N-Methyltryptamine|NMT]].<ref name="Gartz" />

==Substrates suspected to produce neurotoxic compounds==
{{headerpanel|{{Template:Warning/4-PO-5-MeO-DMT and 4-PO-5-HO-DMT}}}}

*[[4-HO-5-MeO-DMT]] (psilomethoxin) mushrooms derived from ''[[Psilocybe cubensis]]'' mycelium in substrate with added [[5-MeO-DMT]].<ref>{{cite journal |vauthors =Julia M, Manoury P, Voillaume MC |title=[No 209 - Recherches en série indolique. XIV (*) - Sur des méthoxy-5 hydroxy-4, méthoxy-5 hydroxy-6 et méthoxy-7 hydroxy-6 tryptamines] |language=fr |journal=Bull Chim Soc Fr |pages=1417–23 |date=1965 }}</ref><ref name="Shulgin Online" />
**'''Uncertain outcome:''' There's no guarantee this modification will create the intended compound 4-PO-5-HO-DMT (psilomethoxin). Research (see a [https://chemrxiv.org/engage/chemrxiv/article-details/64790c6cbe16ad5c57506e4e 2023 preprint]) hasn't been able to confirm psilomethoxin production in lab settings.
